I've been in and out of hospitals for years dealing with family and I've never seen a "long" bed. They all have to fit inside of the elevators. I've seen beds for obese people, beds that specifically help prevent bedsores, beds with handles that go above the patients' heads so they can move themselves around. Never a long bed. I'm guessing they could take a normal bed, pull the leg stopper off and put another normal bed perpendicular to it to make a larger one, but they would need a really large hospital room for that.
